shortDescription: Get physical interfaces with or without their topology from a Gaia Security Gateway or Cluster.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: group_interfaces_by_subnet
options.description: Specify whether to group the cluster interfaces by a subnet. Otherwise, group the cluster interfaces by their names.

options.name: use_defined_by_routes
options.description: Specify whether to configure the topology "Defined by Routes" where applicable. Otherwise, configure the topology to "This Network" as default for internal interfaces.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.

options.name: with_topology
options.description: Specify whether to fetch the interfaces with their topology. Otherwise, the Management Server fetches the interfaces without their topology.
